This '''cavern''' was a base of operations for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] group, the [[Wavelength Gale]]. This large cove was located at the end of a series of long and narrow tunnels, at the base of [[Mount Vorena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. This area was also the final resting place of the ''[[Nashuaga]]'', a [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|''Dynamic''-class freighter]] that crashed onto the planet at some point in the distant past. It was rumored that the [[mask of Darth Nihilus]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], was located in the cargo of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus">''{{WizCite|story=The Mask of Darth Nihilus|book=The Unknown Regions}}''</ref>
